items.x: Mount Kalaga National Park covers the north of the state, up against the border. It’s the only real high ground in Leonida: pine forests, gorges, rivers and waterways running down toward the swamps. Rockstar presents it as the place you go to hunt, fish, camp and drive off-road, away from the bustle of the cities. The official screenshots show enduro bikes and ATVs in the mud, a helicopter over the ridges, hunters in the undergrowth and a kayak under a railroad bridge. On the map, the park brings together the off-road trails and water spots of the north.

items.x: Port Gellhorn had its glory days as a beach resort; only the signs are left. Rockstar describes a city that has lost its prosperity, with its cheap motels, abandoned malls and closed-down attractions, where you can lie low and take the jobs nobody else wants. items.x: A sprawling metropolis in southern Leonida, Vice City is home to pastel art deco hotels, clubs packed with celebrities and the biggest cruise port in the world. Rockstar presents it as a city where people, from Little Cuba to Tisha-Wocka, are always up for a party. Ocean Beach lines up its white sand and 1930s facades; Downtown raises its towers above the bay; VC Port welcomes the cruise ships. This is where Boobie Ike, Dre’Quan Priest and Real Dimez are building their music empire, between the Jack of Hearts and the Only Raw Records studio.

items.h: Jason and Lucia, according to Rockstar
items.x: Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos have always known the deck is stacked against them. When a job that was supposed to be easy goes wrong, they end up on the dark side of the sunniest place in America, at the heart of a criminal conspiracy that stretches across the whole state of Leonida. To make it out, they’ll have to rely on each other more than ever. Jason grew up around grifters, did a stint in the Army and works in the Keys for local drug runners; Lucia is getting out of the Leonida Penitentiary, where fighting for her family landed her.

items.x: Cal Hampton is Jason’s friend and Brian Heder’s associate in the Keys. Rockstar describes him as a man who feels safest at home, where he spends his days monitoring Coast Guard frequencies, with a few beers within reach and some private browsing tabs open. He sees conspiracies everywhere, even in flocks of birds that are a little too well lined up, and wonders whether everything you read online might be true. Happy with his lot in the Keys, he doesn’t share Jason’s ambitions. The official screenshots show him at mini golf, at the pool table and on a float in a pool.

items.t: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album — GTA 6
items.x: Rockstar Games and Atlantic Records announced the album on September 17, 2026. Changing a purchase’s price also changes your budget, your buying order, and “Is it worth it?” Save a copy to compare two versions. Why do Simple and Expert give the same result? The mode changes what you’re shown, not the calculation. Expert lets you change extra settings; going back to Simple doesn’t erase them. Why does no activity fit in my play time?

items.t: Tutorial: learn to use the GTA 6 calculator
items.x: The edition’s retail price in euros isn’t the item’s in-game price in dollars. What’s the difference between My business plan and My progress? My business plan starts from a goal (a purchase or an amount) and your numbers, then gives you the order of the steps and the play time needed. My progress tracks items you check off on the site. Neither of them reads a save from your console. How do I take my data to another device? On the Progress page, export your progress. On the other device, import that file, read the preview, then choose Merge or Replace for the sections in the file.

items.t: Rare and exclusive GTA 6 vehicles: editions and one-off models
items.x: Nobody knows yet how rare a vehicle is in the game: spawn rates, prices and unlock conditions aren’t public. What we can establish right now, though, is commercial exclusivity : vehicles tied to an edition or a pre-order pack, which not every player will get. And the models seen only once , in a single official image. This page lists both, and nothing else. What you won’t find here. No list of “secret vehicles,” no spawn locations, no unlock methods. This information doesn’t exist before November 19, 2026, and any site publishing it today is making it up or taking it from the 2022 leak.
